stages.title: Scope and audit plan
stages.does: Pick the controls from the selection, set period and risk, write the audit plan.

stages.title: Audit lead approves the plan
stages.does: The audit lead approves the plan or asks for changes.

stages.title: Evidence request list
stages.does: Write the request list per control and owner.

stages.title: Test one control
stages.does: Review the evidence for the current control against the criteria.

stages.title: Draw the sample
stages.does: Sample size by population and risk from the methodology table.

stages.title: Draft the finding
stages.does: Write the finding (condition, criteria, cause, effect, recommendation) with evidence ids.

stages.title: Peer review of the finding
stages.does: A senior auditor checks the finding against the review checklist.

stages.title: Audit lead decides the disputed finding
stages.does: Peer review kept asking for changes: the audit lead accepts the finding as it stands or withdraws it.

stages.title: Next control
stages.does: Move to the next control or finish testing.

stages.title: Consolidate the findings
stages.does: Group findings by cause, rate them, write the draft report.

stages.title: Management response
stages.does: The responsible manager accepts or disputes the findings.

stages.title: Quality review of the report
stages.does: Check the report for evidence, rating and wording.

stages.title: Escalate to the audit lead
stages.does: A review loop hit its limit: the audit lead decides.
